study type: Case-control study leveraging registries and a longitudinal cohort, with machine learning analysis.
cohort: The study included 2,571 term-born neonates, comprising 527 cases with idiopathic Perinatal Arterial Ischemic Stroke (PAIS) and 2,044 healthy controls.
finding: A machine learning model accurately predicted PAIS (86.5% balanced accuracy, AUC 0.93) and identified several clinical factors, some previously known and some novel, associated with the condition.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was identified by the machine learning model as an additional variable associated with PAIS.
